summary: Validated cookie+Bearer-token fallback fix. Backend endpoints /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register now return access_token (JWT ~252 chars) in the response body in addition to setting the HttpOnly cookie. Frontend correctly stores JWT in localStorage as 'fironova_token' and uses it via Authorization: Bearer header. E2E login flow succeeds (admin@fironova.com → redirect to /ops-portal-fn7k2q → dashboard renders Revenue $6289.76 / Orders 126 / Customers 24). CRITICAL: Verified Bearer-only auth works after clearing all cookies — user remains authenticated on reload, dashboard still loads (confirms the cookie-less browser scenario the user was hitting is now resolved).

minor.issue: Brute-force throttling appears NOT to trigger 429. 7 consecutive wrong-password attempts on same email all returned 401; no 429 observed. Playbook expects 5-fail lockout. Needs verification/fix.

action_items: Investigate brute-force lockout: expected 429 after 5 failed login attempts, currently continues returning 401. Check rate-limit middleware / login attempt counter (may not be persisted or key may include IP + email but preview traffic through Cloudflare could obfuscate IP). Not blocking for the current fix, but security regression to address.
critical_code_review_comments: Header CORS: response includes 'access-control-allow-origin: *' AND cookie with SameSite=None which is normally rejected by strict browsers with credentials — the Bearer fallback correctly mitigates this. Good defensive design.
The access_token JWT is now duplicated in cookie + response body + localStorage. Acceptable trade-off for compatibility; ensure token rotation/invalidation (tv claim) is respected on both auth paths.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 16: The user-reported bug ('Something went wrong. Please try again.' toast on admin login) is FIXED. Confirmed via 2 Playwright flows: (1) normal login → redirect + dashboard OK, (2) cookies cleared post-login → Bearer token from localStorage keeps user authenticated on reload (dashboard still loads). Backend curl: /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register return access_token in body (verified). Magic-verify endpoint was not tested (requires generating a magic link email) but code path is the same pattern per file references. Minor open issue: brute-force 429 lockout does not appear to trigger — pass to main agent for investigation, not a blocker for the current fix.
rca of the issue: Root cause: browser was blocking the HttpOnly SameSite=None cookie (Cloudflare/preview env returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin:* with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials:true, a combination rejected by strict browsers; also third-party cookie restrictions in iframe/private mode). Mitigation applied by main agent (verified working): login/register/magic-verify now ALSO return the JWT in response body; frontend AuthContext stores it in localStorage; axios interceptor attaches Authorization: Bearer <token>. Both auth paths (cookie & Bearer) remain supported.
